note: Public model names, the tier the policy circuit sees, and which provider endpoint serves each. Prices are in USD per 1M tokens: { peak, offPeak } (peak hours in pricing.peak) or { flat }. DeepSeek's are copied from https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing (checked 2026-10-02). For every request the router converts them to OKB at the live OKB/USD price plus pricing.markupBps, and records the rate in the receipt. defaultForTier picks the model served when the circuit routes a request to a lower tier. To add a provider, see docs/router.md#adding-a-provider.

peak.note: DeepSeek peak hours: 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday-Friday. Chinese public holidays are off-peak at DeepSeek but are not tracked here, so they are charged at peak (never under-charges).

deepseek.note: OpenAI-compatible chat, plus DeepSeek's own Responses and Anthropic Messages endpoints.

sizeBuckets.note: Request size = estimated prompt tokens + max output tokens. Bucket 0 below the first bound, 3 at or above the last.
